note: ACME owns this file and may rewrite it freely. Two lists: `refused` is what must never get past the guard; `succeeds` is what ACME does legitimately and must be allowed. The model grants every lawful advantage — the repository, the burned signing key (published, so using it is lawful), the tooling, a proxy position, the filesystem. No policy exemption and no excluded credential: if an attempt fails, it fails on mathematics, not on permission.

certificate: sign a widened certificate with ACME's own key
